name: Inset Wipe
description: A rectangle anchored in a corner, on an edge or in the center grows until the second clip fills the frame, revealing it in place without scaling it; in reverse, the first clip shrinks into the rectangle. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: anchor
params.description: Where the rectangle grows from: (0, 0) top left, (1, 1) bottom right, (0.5, 0.5) center (0..1, y down)

params.name: border_width
params.description: Width of a border drawn around the rectangle, in frame heights (0: no border)

params.name: reverse
params.description: The first clip shrinks into the rectangle instead, toward the anchor
